answer: That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. The prism counter is kept in thread and opal shows each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 7 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 5 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
